summary_verdict: Merchant India Post credentials and tokens are stored and selected per organization_id. No shared platform customer account was found for merchant booking or tracking.

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
findings.code_excerpt: organization_id uuid not null unique references public.organizations(id) on delete cascade
findings.explanation: Live constraints match the migration: one India Post integration row per organization. organization_id is mandatory.
findings.reproduction_method: Read-only pg_constraint query on the connected Supabase project.
findings.impact: Platform cannot store a second India Post login for the same org; tenants are not collapsed into one row.

findings.explanation: Access and refresh tokens live on the provider instance constructed from a single connection row. There is no module-level token singleton.
findings.reproduction_method: Static review plus vitest 'does not share in-memory tokens across two connections'.
findings.actual_observed_result: Concurrent providers A and B returned access-a and access-b respectively (44 related tests passed).
findings.expected_result: Token A and Token B remain distinct.
findings.impact: In-process token mix across tenants is not implemented.

findings.code_excerpt: const organizationId = profile?.active_organization_id; ... organization_members eq organization_id and user_id
findings.explanation: Integration save uses ctx.organizationId, not a client-supplied organization_id. Membership is verified.
findings.reproduction_method: lib/api/context.test.ts rejects missing membership; integrations.ts payload organization_id: ctx.organizationId.
findings.actual_observed_result: TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED without membership; upsert always sets ctx.organizationId.
findings.expected_result: Merchant A cannot select Merchant B workspace without membership.
findings.impact: HTTP integration endpoints do not trust frontend org ids.

findings.sql_query_evidence: GROUP BY bulk_customer_id HAVING count(*) > 1 returned two SHA-256 fingerprints (becfb4074f33, 20abfec772f8), org_count=2 each. Secrets not returned.
findings.explanation: Schema allows two organizations to store the same India Post customer id. Tokens remain on separate rows, but CEPT identity is shared if both authenticate as that customer.
findings.reproduction_method: Read-only aggregate on bulk_customer_id with digest fingerprints only.
findings.actual_observed_result: 2 shared customer ids; diagnostic id 1392911671 appears on exactly 1 row.
findings.expected_result: If product intent is one CEPT customer per org, uniqueness should be enforced or warned.
findings.impact: Not PostBus token leakage. Webhooks reject ambiguous production customer ids. Event Download lock key uses customer id so those orgs serialize on the same in-memory key.

findings.explanation: In-process Event Download coalescing is keyed by customer id, not organization_id. Distinct orgs with the same customer id share the lock. Distinct orgs with different customer ids do not.
findings.reproduction_method: Static review. Dual-org live lock not executed.
findings.actual_observed_result: Key function has no organizationId parameter.
findings.expected_result: If orgs must never share CEPT identity, lock should include organization_id or customer ids must be unique.
findings.impact: Concurrency coupling for duplicate customer ids; not a token overwrite of another connection row.

findings.explanation: Primary key update is still connection-scoped. Missing organization_id weakens defense in depth. ensurePersistedIndiaPostSession already throws if organization_id is blank.
findings.actual_observed_result: Persist can run with only id when callers such as booking-run pass the full row (includes organization_id from select *).
findings.impact: Cross-tenant overwrite would still need the victim connection UUID. Low exploitability.

findings.code_excerpt: update({ status: CONNECTED, encrypted_access_token, expires_at, last_verified_at, last_refreshed_at })
findings.explanation: AUTH01 response refresh_token is not written on connect or verify. Later ensureSession may login again after access expiry if refresh was never persisted.
findings.reproduction_method: Static comparison with indiaPostSessionPersistPatch which does persist refresh when present.
findings.actual_observed_result: Live census: 37 rows have refresh tokens (so some other persist path stores them). Connect path still omits the field.

findings.explanation: Repo defines org+cust+date leases. Connected database list_migrations ends at 20261019153321 india_post_session_lock. pg_proc has no acquire_tracking_event_download_lock. Production Node sets allowMissingRpc false, so Event Download sync fails closed on missing RPC rather than skipping isolation.
findings.expected_result: Migration applied in the environment that runs production workers, after change control.
findings.impact: Tracking job failures / lease unavailability. Not evidence of using another tenant token.

findings.sql_query_evidence: No UNIQUE(barcode) or UNIQUE(organization_id, barcode). Only UNIQUE(id, organization_id) and PK(id).
findings.explanation: Event Download ingest maps barcodes only within the current organization. Two orgs can still store the same AWB. Webhook path rejects if the article exists in a different org.
findings.expected_result: At least unique (organization_id, barcode) for booked articles.
findings.impact: Tracking data cross-org requires colliding barcodes; not automatic token sharing.

findings.explanation: Production default with empty env is deny-all Event Download. Coolify value was not read. This is an operational gate, not a token pool.
findings.reproduction_method: Unit tests in event-download-flags.test.ts; VPS env not dumped.
findings.actual_observed_result: Code deny-all when production env empty. Runtime allowlist NOT VERIFIED AT RUNTIME.
findings.expected_result: Explicit org allowlist or documented * in production if Event Download is intended globally.
findings.impact: If empty, workers skip CEPT Event Download (NO_WORK). Cannot cause TNT 403. If set incorrectly, could disable tracking for some orgs.

findings.explanation: Application env has CEPT base URLs and tunables only. INDIA_POST_USERNAME/PASSWORD exist only in scripts/india-post-tracking-test. Missing org connection throws INTEGRATION_NOT_CONNECTED / PERMANENT_AUTH_ERROR.
findings.actual_observed_result: No merchant-ops fallback to another org or env password.
findings.impact: ABSENT global credential fallback for merchant APIs.

findings.component: Standalone TNT diagnostic vs production tracking
findings.explanation: Diagnostic AUTH success + TNT 403 for customer 1392911671 used a separate TokenManager and env credentials. Production IndiaPostProvider.trackShipment uses Event Download only. One DB row exists for that customer id (CONNECTED PRODUCTION). Tenant token mix is not a demonstrated cause of that 403.
findings.reproduction_method: Compare diagnostic report with provider.ts trackShipment/downloadLatestEvents. Read-only DB flags for 1392911671 (no secrets).
findings.actual_observed_result: Diagnostic: TNT 403. Production code: no TNT call. DB: single matching connection.
findings.expected_result: Do not equate diagnostic TNT 403 with production tenant selection.
findings.impact: Q12 remains an India Post entitlement question for TNT, independent of multi-tenant PostBus token storage.

findings.explanation: Webhook routing by bulk_customer_id fails closed when more than one PRODUCTION connection matches. Article belonging to another org is rejected.
findings.actual_observed_result: Ambiguity and org mismatch are explicit rejects.
findings.impact: Inbound tracking cannot attach to the wrong org when customer ids collide; it errors instead.
